source: zGsp/Chart/tb_Mob.tbl (truncated in the client: 288 of 370 rows) + zGsp/table/Mon_Data.etb + zGsp/Chart/tb_Mob_Drop.tbl
note: dropGroups = [dropTableId, totalPer] for soul/seal/equip/acc/spend/misc; dropTables[id].items = [itemId, rate/10000] (mob = nExorcizeID column). Monsters without lv/hp exist only in Mon_Data.etb.

1000101.name: 깨부리
1000101.bookDesc: A glowing ghost fireball that is cold to the touch. He's best friends with Neko.

1000201.name: 네코
1000201.bookDesc: A one-eyed Dokebi monster that hangs with Keburi around the Chaste Hall. Unlike his scary looks, he's docile by nature and very clumsy. He constantly falls on the ground and loses his eyeball.

1000301.name: 어인귀
1000301.bookDesc: A hybrid of tuna and man. He's constantly frustrated by his failed transformation, which turned him into a walking fish instead of a handsome Merman with a fishtail.

1000401.name: 해게귀
1000401.bookDesc: Crab, wanting to walk straight, made a deal with the Devil, but it was just a trick to turn him into a monster.

1000501.name: 식인초
1000501.bookDesc: A monstrous plant that shoots poison stings from its mouth with its long tongue. It grows mainly on the Chaste Plains and near Azure River, hogging up all the nutrients in the ground. Its leaves, however, are enriched with beneficial nutrients.

1000601.name: 귀암석
1000601.bookDesc: A possessed rock that wears an exorcising amulet like a war trophy. It hates being called Stone Head, and doesn't like getting smacked on the head.

1000701.name: 전갈신
1000701.bookDesc: A poisonous scorpion that has poor control over his own tail. He frequently pokes himself in the head while trying to attack others. He's a bit slow in the head.

1000702.name: 어린숭숭
1000702.bookDesc: He lost his mother while on the run from some poachers, and arrived alone on the island. He's angry at humans for destroying his home, but his attempts at revenge always end up with him getting nearly beaten to death by the islanders.

1000801.name: 지옥수
1000801.bookDesc: Writhing ghost hands that are trying to bring the living with them to Hell.

1000901.name: 문요어
1000901.bookDesc: A fish that always flies in pairs, and its appearance is believed to be a sign of a good harvest. This particular one is vile and tainted with evil.

1001001.name: 야비
1001001.bookDesc: A dark furry monster with a staff that lives on river plants and herbs around Azure River and Chaste Plains. He hates being called a mutt, but he does look like one.

1001201.name: 사마녀
1001201.bookDesc: A wicked mantis that enjoys stirring up the mud in Azure River or terrorizing the ferryman. Its sharp scythe-like claws leave lasting wounds.

1001301.name: 패귀
1001301.bookDesc: A mutated oyster that survived marine pollution caused by humans. It throws its rotting flesh in an ironic attack.

1001401.name: 우산요괴
1001401.bookDesc: A one-eyed ghost that resides in a torn paper umbrella. He keeps spinning himself to repel water, which sometimes makes him feel dizzy and fall on the ground.

1001501.name: 니코
1001501.bookDesc: A female Neko that inhabits islands. She can be very ferocious, unlike her gentler counterpart, and throws her eyeball at people that bother her.

1001502.name: 파모귀
1001502.bookDesc: A monstrous jellyfish whose tentacles are fine and thin, resembling human hair.

1001601.name: 달걀귀신
1001601.bookDesc: A blank-faced monster whose complete lack of facial features is frightening enough to make onlookers shudder.

1001701.name: 아객귀
1001701.bookDesc: A vengeful ghost of a squirrel that was harassed and abused by humans in life.

1001801.name: 외안귀
1001801.bookDesc: A one-eyed, one-legged monster that despises humans for having two eyes and legs. His tongue attack turns the victim blind.

1001901.name: 사귀향초
1001901.bookDesc: A carnivorous plant whose stench is as bad as carrion. It can swallow more than it looks like it could, so some believe that the plant has a giant gastric organ hidden under the ground.

1002001.name: 태세
1002001.bookDesc: A slime with many eyes that moves more quickly than it looks it would. It can see in all four directions and likes chewing on iron.

1002101.name: 강시
1002101.bookDesc: An animated corpse that hops with both hands held straight forward. When attacked, he relentlessly follows whoever struck him.

1002201.name: 동안귀
1002201.bookDesc: This wicked Buddha walks with his hands behind his back and shoots spit that can even penetrate rock.

1002301.name: 장설아귀
1002301.bookDesc: A Preta that was poisoned by overstuffing himself. It wanders earth with his poisonous tongue hanging out, still craving food.

1002302.name: 조악귀
1002302.bookDesc: A man who made a deal with the Devil and wished to fly like a bird. His contract with the Devil granted his wish at the cost of his soul and ability to speak the human language.

1002401.name: 인조귀
1002401.bookDesc: A half-bird, half-man that is frequently seen flitting over the Reed Field with a victim hanging in his mouth. He's obsessed with keeping his hair groomed neat and smooth.

1002501.name: 가와마
1002501.bookDesc: The spirit of a dead prisoner whose punishment was to work the wheel of the Grim Reaper's chariot. He's still wicked and has managed to escape and come back to earth where he now races recklessly.

1002502.name: 달두꺼비
1002502.bookDesc: A toad made a deal with the Devil, wanting to go to the moon. The Devil fooled him, so he's still stuck on the ground but without his soul.

1002601.name: 거곤층귀
1002601.bookDesc: A snake whose transformation to tortoise failed halfway. It makes awful shrieking noises, and its biting attack immobilizes the victim for a few seconds.

1002701.name: 정혈귀
1002701.bookDesc: An ancient Jiangshi with pallid skin and a red nose that show years of alcohol abuse.

1002702.name: 쌍돈귀
1002702.bookDesc: These pig twins were conjoined by the Devil as punishment for fighting over food, but they still haven't learned their lesson.

1002801.name: 처녀귀신
1002801.bookDesc: The ghost of a woman who died a virgin. She's still wandering earth looking for someone to marry, preferably an attractive mate.

1002901.name: 화언귀
1002901.bookDesc: The vengeful ghost of a mole that was killed because it was mistaken for a raccoon.

1003001.name: 십이요해
1003001.bookDesc: A zodiac animal in the form of a hog. Like everyone else of his kind, he loves eating and hates being called fat. His worst nightmare is being eaten.

1003002.name: 청염깨부리
1003002.bookDesc: A Keburi that is training to become King Keburi. He is much more threatening than the normal Keburi.

1003003.name: 미악혈귀
1003003.bookDesc: Rumor has it that this ferocious beat was created by some scientists, who were studying everything in the world in the Tower of Fate. It has migrated to the forests some time ago

1003101.name: 강하관시
1003101.bookDesc: A dead miner who carries his own coffin around. Still remembering his days of abuse and overwork, he lunges at anyone he sees to get his revenge.

1003201.name: 해골귀
1003201.bookDesc: An animated skeleton that stinks of carrion and makes cackling noise with his teeth.

1003202.name: 농부령
1003202.bookDesc: This farmer mistakenly sold his soul to the Devil for a rotting body and vile crops, instead of the good harvest that he wished he'd have every year.

1003301.name: 지옥혈부
1003301.bookDesc: A mining shovel that is possessed by the vengeful spirit of a dead miner.

1003401.name: 견마귀
1003401.bookDesc: An undead hound that barks too loud and bites everything he sees.

1003402.name: 무당귀
1003402.bookDesc: A misfortunate shaman who happened to call upon an evil spirit.

1003501.name: 기에충
1003501.bookDesc: A blind worm that inhabits the Serpent Lair. It can't move because it can't see, but it can stretch itself very far. It's often mistaken for the Parasite.

1003601.name: 카부
1003601.bookDesc: A Dokebi monster that runs around the Serpent Lair carrying bones. He loves music and dancing, and is especially popular among the ladies for his cute appearance.

1003602.name: 악혼천귀
1003602.bookDesc: This bird was once worshipped by people for its mystic beauty, but he let himself get consumed by Narcissism. Now he's just monstrous.

1003701.name: 요안지
1003701.bookDesc: A spider-like monster with the head of a woman. She thinks she's a spider, but she doesn't have the skills to weave cobwebs. The gorgeous golden color of her torso often leads people to believe she's poisonous.

1003801.name: 이사귀
1003801.bookDesc: An undead snake tamer that carries two snakes wrapped around her body.

1003802.name: 섬월귀
1003802.bookDesc: A vindictive Moon Toad whose obsession with the moon has manifested as deadly poison; Moss Toad's saliva can kill an elephant in a fraction of a second.

1003901.name: 도깨비
1003901.bookDesc: A greedy and mischievous monster with a single horn on his head. He's upset because he broke his precious magic bat by forcing it to make more riches than it could handle.

1004001.name: 십이요술
1004001.bookDesc: A zodiac animal in the form of a dog that resides deep inside the Serpent Lair. He wiggles his tail happily when someone gives him a bone.

1004002.name: 사타견
1004002.bookDesc: The evolved Blood Lynx; its skin has turned ghostly blue. Rumor has it that it's voted the most terrifying monster of all time by the people of Hauntville, but none of the alleged voters will back up this story.

1004101.name: 이빨아래1
1004101.bookDesc: The first artificial creature that Yangak was ever able to create by using necromancy. It roams the Tower of Fate and is rumored to be made by an ex-Shaolin monk.

1004201.name: 외족삼귀
1004201.bookDesc: An ex-karate fighter that lost one leg from abusing his knee with kicks. He's often targeted by herbalists that are after the ginseng he carries for stamina purposes.

1004301.name: 흑용안귀
1004301.bookDesc: The chairman of the Long-haired Monster Club. Rumor has it that his authority is being challenged by Maiden Ghost. He's often seen stuck in the Bamboo Grove with his hair wrapped around a bamboo stem.

1004302.name: 부당태귀
1004302.bookDesc: A Swine that is rotting from the inside out, poisoned by the excessive amount of food it has eaten.

1004401.name: 카푸
1004401.bookDesc: Kapu is jealous of his younger brother Kabu's popularity among the ladies. His only consolation is his superior strength, which allows him to throw bones farther.

1004501.name: 로쿠로쿠비
1004501.bookDesc: A smiley female ghost whose face turns blue, with her neck stretched like a snake, when she's upset. Her neck hasn't shrunk back to normal because Guwaz is gaining more popularity than her among the adventurers.

1004601.name: 뿔도깨비
1004601.bookDesc: A stupid Dokebi who hits himself more with his morning star than his foes. He's easily fooled and is scared of Zodiac Rooster.

1004701.name: 황달팽이귀
1004701.bookDesc: The cleaning crew of the underground world that dissolves any living thing with its foul-smelling mucus. Unlike normal snails, this one has bones, crawling on the ground with two leg-like tentacles.

1004801.name: 산적
1004801.bookDesc: A bandit whose evil karma has caught up with him and turned him into a monster. He has poor oral hygiene, and people can smell his rotting teeth.

1004901.name: 구와즈
1004901.bookDesc: A pretty lady whose back of head is a heinous monster. She uses her beauty to seduce men, and then lets the monster eat them. She always wears a hair scarf to keep her hair in place in case she has to cook outside her house.

1004902.name: 청달팽이귀
1004902.bookDesc: An evolved Yellow Snail who has gained the power of ice at the expense of its speed. Its body is so cold, its sneezes can  instantly freeze a victim.

1005001.name: 십이요유
1005001.bookDesc: A zodiac animal in the form of a rooster. It gets annoyed whenever it's called chicken.

1005002.name: 왕네코
1005002.bookDesc: A giant Neko with the word King written in Chinese on his belly. He's inflated himself with Fury, frustrated with being treated like a weak monster. He rolls his eyeballs to attack and disrupt his enemies.

1005101.name: 통족제비
1005101.bookDesc: A weasel that died, trapped in a barrel which some poachers set as a trap. He moves extremely fast.

1005201.name: 만취너구리
1005201.bookDesc: A shapeshifting raccoon that is too drunk to show off his ability. He roams Dragon Mountain, staggering with a wine bottle dangling on a fishing rod.

1005301.name: 녹달팽이귀
1005301.bookDesc: A snail whose color turned green from eating toxic trash from underground. His slapping tongue attack can poison his victims.

1005302.name: 맹독충
1005302.bookDesc: Yangak's second artificial monster that is based on Sightless Worm, the minion of the Great Monster. Its breath is so poisonous, it can actually kill from a distance.

1005401.name: 흑웅
1005401.bookDesc: An animated bear corpse that lost his gall bladder to a poacher that wanted enhanced vigor. He mainly appears in Dragon Mountain, and attacks with parasite tentacles on his back.

1005501.name: 혈랑
1005501.bookDesc: A wolf that died before he could become the Pet Wolf. His grudge is the only thing that keeps him going.

1005502.name: 심연귀
1005502.bookDesc: A half-dead anglerfish that gained the ability to breathe and fly in the air. It's hiding another mouth inside the mouth, shooting it in a surprise attack. Sometimes, the two mouths say different things at the same time.

1005601.name: 아귀
1005601.bookDesc: A ghost that suffers from insatiable hunger and thirst. He goes wherever food is, and does not hesitate to coerce people into giving him food.

1005701.name: 왕깨부리
1005701.bookDesc: A giant Keburi that has inflated itself to retaliate at the people that bullied him.

1005702.name: 적달팽이귀
1005702.bookDesc: This most evolved Snail has turned its bodily fluid into powerful acid that melts everything it touches. Sometime it screams in pain, accidentally spilling its acid on itself while trying to attack people.

1005801.name: 충욕토
1005801.bookDesc: A mutated earthworm that has been influenced by the power of darkness. It spits its young from its stomach to attack. Whoever eats these Parasite Eggs will transform into Parasites.

1005802.name: 은갑이
1005802.bookDesc: Yangak's third creation is a corpse plated with thin silvery foil. The foil supposedly keeps the necromancy spell in place, but it's not working.

1005901.name: 우인귀
1005901.bookDesc: This undead bull returned to life to get revenge on the man that slaughtered him for his meat. He walks on two feet and wields a giant axe.

1006001.name: 십이요신
1006001.bookDesc: A zodiac animal in the form of a monkey. He shrieks in the night, disturbing the slumber of the people in his vicinity. He creates three mirror images to attack his enemies. His weakness, naturally, is bananas.

1006002.name: 왕달팽이귀
1006002.bookDesc: A Snail that has grown too big from its gluttonous eating. It's so powerful, it can singlehandedly bring disaster to the entire world, but only if it can get out of its lair.

1006003.name: 명거_1_왼손
1006003.bookDesc: This giant Dokebi almost wiped out the food supply of the entire Netherworld with his outrageous appetite. He came to this realm through a dimensional gap, which he found accidentally, looking for even more food to eat.

1006101.name: 요수귀
1006101.bookDesc: This mythical creature was once considered the patron deity of lakes and ponds. The recent water contamination and emergence of evil have turned him into a heinous monster.

1006201.name: 우렁각시
1006201.bookDesc: A half-woman, half-snail monster that failed her transformation halfway and lost her chance to become a human bride. She holds a grudge against men.

1006401.name: 백용안귀
1006401.bookDesc: Pale Face Ghost curses every living thing and the entire world, even more than the Dark Face Ghost, because of his ruined face.

1006601.name: 거암귀
1006601.bookDesc: This slate was to be used for building Dragon Castle, but it was abandoned when the constructors discovered that wood from the Rocky Mountains was much more durable.

1006701.name: 쪽박귀신
1006701.bookDesc: A housewife ghost who was abused by her mother-in-law and husband in life. She hysterically throws her bowl in rage.

1006801.name: 몬코
1006801.bookDesc: A one-eyed, one-legged furry monster that lurks in the mountains. He throws poison sacks at travelers to incapacitate them and steal their valuables. He looks like a big bully, but he's sensitive about the smell of his foot.

1006901.name: 시폭귀
1006901.bookDesc: An artificial monster that has an evil spirit trapped in his explosive stone body. Yangak has programmed it to self-destruct as soon as it detects an enemy to kill.

1007001.name: 십이요미
1007001.bookDesc: A zodiac animal in the form of a lamb that commands monsters from the top of the Rocky Mountains. He's obsessed with grooming his hair and electrically shocks anyone that tries to touch him.

1007002.name: 혈갑문
1007002.bookDesc: Yangak has created this artificial creature based on the gatekeeper of the Netherworld to keep intruders away from the Haunted Castle.

1007101.name: 이목귀
1007101.bookDesc: The spirit of a tree that was worshiped by shamans. It rose from the ground out of anger when people wiped out a whole forest of trees to build Dragon Castle. Totem Ent and Stone Slate blame each other for their misery.

1007201.name: 야광귀
1007201.bookDesc: A mischievous imp that likes playing pranks on people from nearby villages. His face is stuck to a hahoe mask that he stole from a villager, and it now seems to be permanently fused into him.

1007401.name: 마란
1007401.bookDesc: In the age of Great Master Taihe, some monsters hid themselves in these eggs. A high monk of the Tian Temple used an amulet to permanently seal them inside.

1007501.name: 삼족오
1007501.bookDesc: This three-legged raven was once worshipped by people for its striking resemblance to the Three-legged Bird that is believed to live alongside the Sun God.

1007701.name: 구미호
1007701.bookDesc: A thousand-year-old fox that can shapeshift into almost anything, save for her ever conspicuous nine tails. She lurks on mountain trails to lure travelers and steal their livers, which she needs for her complete transformation into a woman.

1007901.name: 불가사리
1007901.bookDesc: A half-elephant, half-tiger monster that eats every piece of iron it sees. A fugitive monk created this creature to deter the soldiers that were after him.

1008001.name: 십이요오
1008001.bookDesc: An alpha stallion that neighs loudly every night to call mares in the Rocky Vale. He's so wild and ferocious that he can't be tamed by conventional means.

1008101.name: 암자귀
1008101.bookDesc: He was once a royal member of the fallen Cult that used to rule the Tower of Fate. He died protecting the tower and trying to give the cult authority a chance to run away.

1008102.bookDesc: When the Tower of Fate was taken over, some members of the Cult attempted teleportation to the Netherworld. The spell failed miserably. Trans Tainted Ninja became stuck between this realm and the other, which made his body transparent.

1008201.name: 사또귀
1008201.bookDesc: A magistrate that has risen from the dead, unable to forget the love of his life. She's long gone, however, and he's stuck in this realm.

1008202.name: 검은먼지요괴
1008202.bookDesc: A parasite that lives by clinging to the living walls of the Haunted Castle. When the walls are attacked, this monster takes off to find a new host.

1008301.name: 두부동승
1008301.bookDesc: This monk appears before hungry adventurers and offers a slice of tofu. This tofu is actually a mass of poison the monk spit out. It rots whoever eats it from the inside out, turning him into stinky tofu.

1008401.name: 참수귀
1008401.bookDesc: The shadow of a dead headsman who worked for the Cult. He roams inside the Tower of Fate, swinging his sword in search of a head to cut.

1008501.name: 화염귀
1008501.bookDesc: An artificial creature of the Cultists that has the body of a human prisoner inserted with a fire crystal. Its body burns with everlasting fire, and it screams with pain that echoes through the Tower of Fate.

1008601.name: 기암석귀
1008601.bookDesc: The Cultists created this giant to protect their secrets, keep them even from their other members. Although the Cultists were gone, the giant remains in the Tower of Fate to perform his guard duty.

1008602.bookDesc: When the Tower of Fate was taken over, some members of the Cult attempted teleportation to the Netherworld. The spell failed miserably. Trans Rock Giant became stuck between this realm and the other, which made his body transparent.

1008701.name: 화등
1008701.bookDesc: This possessed lantern lures lost travelers with its bright light and burns them alive. Rumor has it that this monster is the offspring of Keburi and Neko.

1008901.name: 기구혈귀
1008901.bookDesc: A genetically modified Eye Slime that is made to guard the Tower of Fate alongside Rock Giant. It hides in the Netherworld, peeking through the tower walls with tentacle-like eyes to watch for intruders.

1009001.name: 십이요사
1009001.bookDesc: One of the Zodiac monsters that have emerged in the Tower of Fate some time ago. It has the key to the high levels of the tower, but is unable to use it since it has no arms or fingers to operate the pairing lock.

1009002.name: 은공이
1009002.bookDesc: An incomplete creature that hatched from the Silver Man Egg without legs. He crawls on the ground slowly, but he's effective in combat.

1009101.name: 진염귀
1009101.bookDesc: This united form of multiple Red Flames generates tremendous heat that can instantly melt iron. It used the hot wind it generated to escape the tower.  It's currently hiding out in the Hermit Mountains, preying on both people and animals.

1009201.name: 독운귀
1009201.bookDesc: This old dwarf woman spent her entire life locked inside the Tower of Fate and making poison for the Cultists. When the Cult fell, she stayed in the upper levels of the tower because she can never find the exits.

1009301.name: 맹독포귀
1009301.bookDesc: She secretly escaped the Tower of Fate from the Cultists by using explosive poison to burn holes through the walls. She's currently hiding in the ruins of the Hermit Mountains before resuming her journey back north where her hometown is.

1009401.name: 원귀갑
1009401.bookDesc: This Cultist armor is possessed by the spirit of its owner, who died protecting the Tower of Fate. Although the Cult fell a long time ago, this armor remains in the tower, watching for intruders.

1009501.name: 인영조귀
1009501.bookDesc: This manifestation of the dark energy in the Tower of Fate has its lower body rooted in Hell. Because it feeds on fear and everything with a shadow, eradicating this monster requires a powerful light.

1009502.bookDesc: When the Tower of Fate was taken over, some members of the Cult attempted teleportation to the Netherworld. The spell failed miserably. Trans Shadow Slime became stuck between this realm and the other, which made his body transparent.

1009701.name: 흑수목귀
1009701.bookDesc: The first prototype Bloody Ent; the Cultists created this artificial monster by infusing a vengeful spirit into Stone Wood, which is stronger than stone. It swallows living people and animals whole.

1009702.bookDesc: When the Tower of Fate was taken over, some members of the Cult attempted teleportation to the Netherworld. The spell failed miserably. Trans Dark Ent became stuck between this realm and the other, which made his body transparent.

1009901.name: 적수목귀
1009901.bookDesc: A Dark Ent infused with sap that nurtures the real Blood Pit Tree. The pigment in the sap has turned its entire body red. When attacked, this tree bleeds this sap, which burns bare skin with its high level of acid.

1009902.bookDesc: When the Tower of Fate was taken over, some members of the Cult attempted teleportation to the Netherworld. The spell failed miserably. Trans Blazing Ent became stuck between this realm and the other, which made his body transparent.

1010001.name: 은관위
1010001.bookDesc: Yangak's second lieutenant possesses incredible powers. He has a strong rivalry with his partner Gold Guard. Both guards can be divided and then controlled easily.

1010003.name: 혈옥수
1010003.bookDesc: The ultimate creation of the Cultists that is based on the Demon Ent of Netherworld. After they were subjugated by Great Master Taihe, this tree assumed the reigns of the tower.

1010005.name: 혈옥수가지2
1010005.bookDesc: When the Tower of Fate fell, some Cultist scientists sought refuge to the West through Hauntville. Emperor Yangak took them into his wings in exchange for full disclosure of their technologies.

1010006.name: 혈옥수가지3
1010006.bookDesc: Silver Claw, by experimenting on his own body, has developed technologies beyond necromancy that enabled him to enlarge living monsters.

1010007.name: 혈옥수뿌리
1010007.bookDesc: Silver Claw, by experimenting on his own body, has developed technologies beyond necromancy. This humongous Eye Slime is one example of his work. Silver Claw had high hopes that this Eye Slime would be better than the useless Giant Keburi.

1010101.name: 산고
1010101.bookDesc: Yeti was a good monster that tried to live in harmony with humans until the Great Monster broke out of his seal. Now she shows extreme hostility toward humans after being influenced by the evil energy of the Great Monster.

1010201.bookDesc: Encouraged by the great success of Bloody Ent, the Cultist scientists created a giant flying monster called Haunted Castle, and this core is an engine that moves the Castle.

1010202.bookDesc: Encouraged by the great success of Bloody Ent, the Cultist scientists created a giant flying monster called Haunted Castle, and this core is an engine that moves the Castle.

1010203.bookDesc: Encouraged by the great success of Bloody Ent, the Cultist scientists created a giant flying monster called Haunted Castle, and this core is an engine that moves the Castle.

1010301.name: 조골귀
1010301.bookDesc: The Kingdom of Mowon beyond the northern mountains has a custom of burning a bird alongside a corpse, believing that the bird would lead the dead to Heaven.

1010401.name: 퇴부도
1010401.bookDesc: A hybrid of buffalo and man that is synonymous with laziness and indolence. Legend says that he was so lazy, he starved himself to death. He also has poor oral hygiene, and his breath is bad enough to knock a person out.

1010501.name: 저승사자
1010501.bookDesc: Grim Reapers harvest souls for Yama, the ruler of Hell, but this particular one has fallen victim to the wicked power of the Great Monster. Now he's collecting souls for his new boss.

1010701.name: 이두광계
1010701.bookDesc: This ferocious rooster was born two-headed, but one head killed the other right after birth. It lives deep inside a snow mountain to keep the dead head preserved.

1010801.name: 설녀
1010801.bookDesc: Legend says this female monster appears in mountains in the midst of winter to lure lost travelers, and then turns them into ice statues for her collection. Her innocent smile hides her true malevolence.

1010901.name: 빙극인
1010901.bookDesc: A sculptor carved this doll out of ice to look like his late wife. His lunacy and obsession with perfection have manifested as the forces that animate this doll.

1011001.name: 십이요진
1011001.bookDesc: Once a good deity, this dragon was tainted with evil during his extended stay on earth. He now blames humans for his fall from grace. He lurks on the Hermit Peaks, waiting to lash out at any passerby.

1011201.name: 비괴어
1011201.bookDesc: An undead fish that achieved his dream of flight after death. He lives deep inside misty mountains to keep his scales from drying out in the air.

1011401.name: 동자선
1011401.bookDesc: Most deities are good, but this little one was born evil. He wears a mask to hide his identity and acts like a monster, taking pleasure out of people's pain.

1011501.name: 천도신
1011501.bookDesc: He was expelled from Heaven for stealing Heavenly Peaches from Yu Di, the Emperor of Heaven. Now he works at a peach garden on the Hermit Peaks, pestering travelers as his side job.

1011601.name: 불량숭숭
1011601.bookDesc: A delinquent SoongSoong that is extremely violent toward his kind and others alike. He often attacks the young, so Mother SoongSoongs stay alert when he's around.

1011801.name: 편마귀
1011801.bookDesc: Bats are unrivaled when it comes to searching for food. These inhabitants of Peril Ravine can smell food from miles away, and they aren't afraid to kill their prey.

1011901.name: 제웅
1011901.bookDesc: A voodoo doll that was used to curse someone over a long period of time. It has a grudge against humans, who are the reason why nails constantly pierce its chest.

1012001.name: 십이요묘
1012001.bookDesc: One of the Zodiac animals that command the monsters of the Peril Ravine. Unlike his innocent rabbit-like appearance, he's the most violent among the twelve. He uses a storm of leaves that cuts like blades through flesh.

1012002.name: 어미숭숭
1012002.bookDesc: SoongSoongs have lost their forest to humans and were forced to settle in the barren Peril Ravine. Mother SoongSoongs are docile, but they are very protective of their young.

1012101.name: 혈강시
1012101.bookDesc: The animated corpse of a man who was killed by monsters. Without a proper burial or prayers for his peaceful rest, he remains bound to the earth.

1012201.bookDesc: It is an artificial creature newly appear in the army of Yangak. Nothing can match its wickedness.

1012301.name: 후안귀
1012301.bookDesc: An undead pet monkey that was abandoned by his owner. He has a deeply rooted rage against humans..

1012401.bookDesc: As Yangaks need more monsters to strengthen its force, it eventually started to kidnap pure monsters. SnowGirl was the first one who spent countless years locked up in the castle.

1012501.name: 야만족
1012501.bookDesc: The Barbarians, a tribe of primitive men, have lived at the Old Ferry long before merchants took it over. They turned into monsters after eating raw fish for so long since some fish happened to be possessed by evil.

1012601.bookDesc: GoldMan was developed under the ambitious plan of Yangak. In fact, it is simply finished by painting SilverMan in Gold.

1012701.name: 화차륜
1012701.bookDesc: He was once the Judge of the Fire Hell where prisoners are crushed by a blazing wagon wheel. His extreme cruelty eventually transformed him into a monster.

1012901.bookDesc: PoisonWorm got evolved into DarkPoisonWorm through a number of poison resistant labs. It has deadly bad breathe and toxic odor.

1013001.name: 십이요인
1013001.bookDesc: A hot-tempered, aggressive tiger that destroyed the Old Ferry out of anger. He left his mountain to calm down by the cool water of the river.

1013002.name: 먹우귀
1013002.bookDesc: A writing brush of a man who had to give up on his studies to support his family. It moves around on its own, doodling on every surface it sees. It only draws unintelligible scribbles, never any meaningful messages.

1013101.bookDesc: Die! That's the only way to live. This monster is designed by improving the flaw of Bombardier. If you get caught up in an explosion, it's over.

1013102.bookDesc: Result or test of GoldClaw's experiment. It seems that there is almost no difference among GiantEyeSlime.

1013201.name: 홍살이귀신
1013201.bookDesc: A tiger that is possessed by the spirit of its own victims.

1013202.bookDesc: Another result or test of GoldClaw's experiment. GoldClaw strongly believes that this test reached better achievement than what SilverClaw had proceeded. But, no one can tell the points…

1013301.bookDesc: Upgrade version of BlackDust which is a parasite on Haunted Castle wall. It is hard to tell the difference between BlackDust and EvilBlackDust.

1013302.bookDesc: Once upon a time, there was an exceptionally jealous scientist in Chaos. He made himself GoldClaw because he didn't want to lose when his partner became SilverClaw. GoldClaw, who hated losing to SilverClaw.

1013401.name: 족자요녀
1013401.bookDesc: This possessed picture of a beautiful fairy lures its viewers to eat them alive. Rumor has it that it was drawn with the blood of a woman who was rejected by her love for being fat.

1013601.name: 흑하동
1013601.bookDesc: A kappa that is covered with black crude oil. Rumor has it that this monster was once a man, and that its spit is so acidic that it can melt steel armor.

1013701.name: 촉음
1013701.bookDesc: This monster was once a weather god worshipped by a small nation. When the nation fell by the hand of Yangak, he lost all his worshippers and power. Now he's just a monster that lives under the ground and feeds on people's life force.

1013901.name: 맹파귀
1013901.bookDesc: A mysterious monster that emerged at the same time as Conch Isle. Its strange eyes and lanky tentacles indicate that it came from the deep sea. It uses its skin to smell and find creatures to suck out their life force.

1014001.name: 십이요축
1014001.bookDesc: A cruel and ruthless monster that turned all the deities in the Sunyu Vale into his minions.

1014002.name: 흉안마녀
1014002.bookDesc: A monstrous wench that feeds on carrion and assimilates corpses into her body. Some say she's made of sand, but no one has gotten close enough to her to confirm this or lived long enough to tell it.

1014003.bookDesc: GoldTorso  was reborn from Torso Egg. However, no one has ever seen a complete one.

1014101.name: 동중조귀
1014101.bookDesc: An enormous parasitic insect that feeds on the blood and flesh of large animals. It has ingested so much blood that its hair has turned blood red.

1014102.name: 호리병귀
1014102.bookDesc: An exhausted-looking imp that carries a giant calabash on his back.

1014103.bookDesc: EvilRedFlame, credited as one of the the best guard of Yangaks, was developed by Chaos in a way to be more tolerance to flame.

1014201.name: 사봉귀
1014201.bookDesc: A monster bee that has migrated to the mysterious Conch Isle from the West. The poison from one of its stings is rumored to be powerful enough to kill a thousand men.

1014203.bookDesc: Yangaks had developed EvilBlazingEnt as a guard to strengthen its force.

1014204.bookDesc: A more powerful modification of a Headsman. It becomes more aggressive and heinous.

1014301.name: 귀면갈신
1014301.bookDesc: A scorpion that has the face of a woman on its back and an amulet tied over its face with a rope. Rumor has it that a powerful conjuror made the amulet to contain the spirit of a monster, and he lost it while fighting his enemies.

1014302.name: 비파요녀
1014302.bookDesc: A thousand-year-old mandolin settled in Sunyu Cave and meditated under the moonlight for a hundred years to become a deity. When a gust of wind brought in evil energy, its meditation was interrupted at the critical moment.

1014303.bookDesc: PoltergeistArmor became more violent and violent. Losing their pride as a warrior, they swing their swords at everything they see. They are now called HardYangakSpectreArmor...

1014401.name: 비촌
1014401.bookDesc: A hybrid of snake and man created from a murderer who was burned to death; the length of the tail indicates the degree of cruelty of the murder he committed. He breathes fire at his victims, and seems to enjoy watching them suffer.

1014403.bookDesc: Yangak gifted special power to ShadowSlime in order for them to perfectly adapt to Haunted Castle's environment.

1014501.name: 삼강동전
1014501.bookDesc: Four small tortoises that move as one unit. These tiny tortoises lived peacefully until humans destroyed their habitats in the rivers and streams, forcing them to migrate to Conch Isle. Now they show undying hatred towards humans.

1014502.name: 늙은로쿠
1014502.bookDesc: A feeble old deity who lost his mind when the dark energy of evil fell upon his home in Sunyu Vale.

1014503.name: 초로쿠
1014503.bookDesc: A berserk Old Loku; he may be old and senile, but his punches are still quite powerful.

1014601.name: 유곤층귀
1014601.bookDesc: This monster, which looks like a hodgepodge mix of other monsters, is also known as the Child of Conch Isle among the people that believe that the isle is a living creature. It hovers over the isle, belching out dust and sand.

1014602.name: 동래적색괴
1014602.bookDesc: A flying jellyfish that has its head and arms hidden inside its bowl-shaped glistening stomach. Its tentacles cause powerful electric shocks to anything they touch.

1014603.bookDesc: GreyYabi's whole body is covered with white hair. It carries a staff everywhere it goes. Its white hair makes it look similar to fluffy dogs. GreyYabi used to eat fresh herb but, since Dead Man’s Valley has been changed, it is not picky about the condition of herb.

1014604.bookDesc: This ghostly egg ghost is not easy to eliminate with a simple physical attack because it is squashy and sticky.

1014701.name: 육안귀
1014701.bookDesc: A six-eyed monster that appears to be a hybrid of a snail and turtle. Its rocky shell enables it to hide in its surroundings on Conch Isle.

1014702.bookDesc: Non-human monster which is created by genius scientists who worked for Chaos side.

1014703.bookDesc: EvilCelestialBird, a fallen angel bird, is very aggressive and has strong beak that can pierce thick armors.

1014704.bookDesc: After the collapse of religion, the zealots who have survived from Tower of Life and Death have studied the HeadsMan. Eventually, they have created this monster, which is far more stronger than HeadsMan.

1014801.name: 수금아
1014801.bookDesc: A hybrid of snake and woman that despises humans for having labeling her as evil. She's migrated to Conch Isle, attracted by the wicked energy that surrounds it. It spits out poison that can instantly melt down steel.

1014803.bookDesc: An armor that upper class warrior used to equip in the battlefield. During religion collapse, some priests used necromantic skills on the armor for the purpose of their safe. As a result, Dead man’s spirit has been sent to this DarkSpectreArmor.

1014804.bookDesc: Bandit, who used to block trading routes in Dead Man’s Valley for toll fee, has become monster due to Power of Great Monster. The reason why it wears crown, it believes itself as King of Dead Man’s Valley.

1014901.name: 탄주어
1014901.bookDesc: An enormous octopus that swallows many things in one gulp. Its huge mouth is filled with digestive fluid that burns away its victims.

1014902.bookDesc: EvilZodiacLamb, one of the Zodiac creatures that is mainly in charge of Gold Guard's armed escort.

1014903.bookDesc: EvilZodiacDragon is one of the powerful beings who secure the control center. It is said that one of ZodiacDragon followed Gold Guard and become Control Center Guard thanks to teaching of Gold Guard.

1014904.bookDesc: It is a guard to protect priests, which is made of rocks in Dead Man’s Valley when religion collapses.

1014905.bookDesc: BlackGrimReaper has sent by King of Underworld for the purpose of managing GrimReapers on the earth. However, its power has been overwhelmed by Power of Great Monster, and has become monster.

1015001.name: 십이요자
1015001.bookDesc: 원래는 지상의 모든 정보들을 천계에 전달하는 사자(使者)였다. 허나 자신을 천대시하는 천계와 인간계에 분노하여 전달의 능력으로 각종 질병을 천계와 지상에 전달해 대혼란을 일으킨 전적이 있다.

1015002.name: 사룡
1015002.bookDesc: An unholy dragon that has lost his heavenly powers to darkness. He's very powerful and loathes everything holy.

1015003.bookDesc: GoldGuard, the supreme position of Yangak guard, is very strong but he is also well known as arrogant and imperious. He does not show up easily except for the big event.

1015004.bookDesc: The Haunted Castle dominated by GoldGuard is occupied with more forces compared to SilverGuard. Thus, it requires a high quality of power core.

1015006.bookDesc: The Haunted Castle dominated by GoldGuard is occupied with more forces compared to SilverGuard. Thus, it requires a high quality of power core.

1015007.bookDesc: The Haunted Castle dominated by GoldGuard is occupied with more forces compared to SilverGuard. Thus, it requires a high quality of power core.

1015008.bookDesc: They look like simple gates but were once the gatekeepers of the netherworld.  Reborn as EvilArmoredGate in order to protect enhanced Haunted Castle.

1015102.bookDesc: It is said that this monster is used to live in Dead Man’s Valley with its tribe. It became monster as it swallows haunted weed.

1015103.bookDesc: This monster has summoned by the monk who has been chased by imperial palace guards. It is better to hide iron-made stuffs when facing the monster because it will swallow them all.

1015201.name: 식인통발
1015201.bookDesc: A carnivorous plant with a toothy mouth that moves with leg-like roots. Its main habitat is the Giant Tree, and flowers around it always die before they can bloom. It bites and spits poisonous mucus to attack its prey.

1015401.name: 백족신사
1015401.bookDesc: This worm looks like a man wearing a coat and a top hat with a cane in hand. He fancies himself a gentleman, but his treatment toward travelers of the Giant Tree is far from gentlemanly.

1015601.name: 괴저충
1015601.bookDesc: A monster that used to be a common worm found on trees. When the army of darkness invaded the human world, it transformed into a soldier clad in durable metal armor. It has eyes on its back and a mouth filled with sharp small teeth.

1015801.name: 주견사
1015801.bookDesc: A subterranean spider that has moved above ground to seek prey. It shoots ethereal cobwebs from its mouth to trap its victims, before crushing them with its weight.

1016002.name: 향량
1016002.bookDesc: A ferocious monster that is also called the Devil of the Giant Tree. It's so violent, some believe that it preys on both friends and foe. It's covered with an armor-like shell and attacks victims with its sharp fangs and tail.

1016101.bookDesc: Zombies are commonly seen in graveyards and battlefields where carrion is abundant, but they prefer to eat the fresh flesh of the living. They also like to snack on corpse bugs.

1016201.bookDesc: A type of demon that lives deep under the ground. Most demons cannot appear on earth unless summoned, but somehow this one has made his way above the ground without any help.

1016302.bookDesc: Formed by the Ruler of dreams, which resembles the appearance of the Zodiac monster that lives at the top of Rocky Mountains. A vicious monster who has mastered the concept of static electricity and utilizes it to cause damage.

1016401.bookDesc: A burning spirit of a soldier who died while longing for his girlfriend. His strong desire for love has bounded him to earth, setting everything around him on fire.

1016402.bookDesc: Formed by the Ruler of dreams, which resembles the appearance of the Zodiac monster that lives at the top of Rocky Gorge. Utilizes strong wind to corner its victims and pummel them to exhaustion.

1016501.bookDesc: An apostate monk who chose the power of black magic over his faith to God. His overwhelming power, however, is costing him his life; he's always on the hunt to steal life force from others.

1016502.bookDesc: Formed by the Ruler of dreams, where originally was the Zodiac monster that ruled the monsters in Tower of Fate. Depending on its mood, it is able to spread wide range of poisonous energy across the map, where its own servants and ruling monsters tend to avoid.

1016602.bookDesc: Formed by the Ruler of dreams, where originally was the dragon who could not fulfill the duties from the Heaven and transformed itself into an evil monster. Like its cold disposition, it utilizes ice to freeze its victims.

1016701.bookDesc: A powerful Crustacean species that live deep inside the ground. Their strong teeth enables them to crunch the minerals inside the Norudam's cave and it is known for its violence and hard backshell. It does not tolerate anyone to trespass its territory

1016702.bookDesc: Formed by the Ruler of dreams, where originally was the Zodiac monster that ruled the monsters in Peril Raven . Like the deceptive appearance of a rabbit, with its sharp teeth hidden under the innocent face, it tricks its victims with wide vareity of tactics. One second of distraction is all it takes for it to take your life away.

1016801.bookDesc: The leftover energy fragments of divine punishment that caused the disintegration of the Ancient Norudam Empire. It roams around the Norudam's cave and acts as the guardian of the goddess, who once tried to seal the cave.

1016802.bookDesc: Formed by the Ruler of dreams, where originally was the Zodiac monster that ruled the Old ferry which resembles the image of a tiger. Its proficiency in handling fire is a fearful attribute to all monsters. It is believed that there is rivalry between the Zodiac dragon and the Zodiac Tiger.

1016902.bookDesc: Formed by the Ruler of dreams, a fearless monster that turned the deities in Sunyu Vale into its servants. It possesses the ability to alter the configuration of the land, thus it is difficult to fight against this monster on the ground.

1017002.bookDesc: The men of Norudam Cave, who became extinct along with the ancient Norudam Empire due to the goddess's wrath had gained peril evil energy and became vicious monsters. Its despise and hate for the goddess remains unchanged and its protruding eye at the back is always staring at the sky, portraying its eternal abomination of the goddess.

1017003.bookDesc: Formed by the Ruler of dreams, where originally was the Zodiac monster that delivered messages from the human world to the Heaven, who is now the cause of almost all existing diseases. As known, the places that this monster touch or passed by decays into a disgusting place.

1017101.bookDesc: It was one of the well-known treasure hunting thieves back in the days near Angora Dessert. The accumulation of curses and ominous energy from stolen tokens have turned them into monsters.

1017102.bookDesc: A monster that digs around under the sand of desert. Originally it was a fish living over the West sea, but the monster evolved itself to fit into a desert habitat by accepting ablilities from an ancient dragon. It has a strong hatred towards humans and it loses its mind when it sees a fishing hook

1017201.bookDesc: The artificial monster created by the Religious group, who utilized the abilities of Blazing ent and Dark Ents together to fabricate a stronger monster. Its long hair is quite conspicuous

1017202.bookDesc: VoraciousHog used to be livestock  to the people of GreenPlain, but became a monster alongside GreenAborigine by accepting ablilities from the Old Dragon. This monster is the main reason the fertile GreenPlain has turned into a desert, as it eats up as much as it can swallow.

1017301.bookDesc: The artificial monster created by the Religious group, who utilized the abilities of Blazing ent and Dark Ents together to fabricate a stronger monster. It is much stronger than the WoodenBigFoot

1017302.bookDesc: The Natives of GreenPlain lost the war against Kingdom of Angora and fleed to the Mountain of the  Old Dragon, pledging allegiance and surrendering themselves to its power in hopes of getting revenge. It hid itself after the Old Dragon was sealed by the Old Monks, but recently its tracks have been re-appearing.

1017401.bookDesc: A monster created by the Religious groups, who conducted human experiments on the past prisoners. These monsters have lost all of their past memories and conscience, only left with desire for killing and human flesh.

1017402.bookDesc: A horse that used to live on the Mountain of the Old Dragon, but was transformed into a monster due to the Dragon's ability. The horse alone had great power and possessed a fierce nature, but the Old Dragon's abilities made it extremely vicious. The Kingdom of Angora has even Blacklisted this monster, requesting travelers to avoid it at all costs.

1017501.bookDesc: These monsters have became monsters themselves by forming a contract with the monsters of the Netherworld. It possesses a very strong power and its primary goal is to engender dismay and disturbance in the world.

1017502.bookDesc: These monsters have also became monsters themselves by forming a contract with Netherworld Monsters. They possesses even stronger power and force than the NohoSpiritApostles.

1017601.bookDesc: MutatedYeti used to dwell on cold central distinct. However, some scientists had intentionally moved them to Mt. AncientDragon for the purpose of testing its viability at different temperature. MutatedYeti has become grey color because voltaic ash stick to its fur.

1017701.bookDesc: It physically looks similar to sticky jelly, which has created by spirit adhere to magma.

1017801.bookDesc: Hellhound is well known as guardian animals of Hell. After migration of AncientDragon on Mt AncientDragon, hell gate to real world has been opened and it has come through the gate.

1017802.bookDesc: LittleFlameDragon, is believed to be descendants of Ancient Dragon, has appeared on the world after migration of AncientDragon.Since LittleFlameDragon is not fully grown, it lives under the protection of mature FlameDragon.

1017901.bookDesc: According to old literature, many Angora soldiers have failed to evacuate from volcanic eruption. Eventually, died soldier spirits became FlameSkeleton. Fire on skeleton never die unless they are being eliminated.

1018001.bookDesc: Many people believe that FlameDragon is offspring of Ancient Dragon, AncientDragon. Since FlameDragon is very difficult for Savers to hunt down, its scales have been trading at high price among merchants.

1018101.bookDesc: Half human-half spider monster. It is characterized by legs with fluffy furs.

1018102.bookDesc: Monster in the shape of a snake. It is noteworthy that the body has evolved to adapt to its surroundings.

1018103.bookDesc: Originally he was an eternal-god being. Whilst visiting the earthling and the world, he changed into a monster because of Great Monster. A disfigured shadow of a horse-like figure, It is described to have a face of a human, tiger’s body, wings of a bird, and the legs of a horse.

1018201.bookDesc: This is known as reinforced Arachne. The form in which furious Arachne unleashed power.

1018202.bookDesc: It is said that, unlike BlackApophis, WhiteApophis had turned to be white because of the strong toxicity of its poison.

1018203.bookDesc: This is an artificial doll made of stones from Burning Ruins. The doll once used to play a role in protecting villagers as spirit beings.

1018301.bookDesc: To get used to the Black Hills, it had to change to dark and black.

1018302.bookDesc: An artificial creature created by an unknown scientist. It is very muggy than any other object in the world. Since the skeleton of the lower body does not exist, it looks like crawling around when walking.

1018303.bookDesc: The ones with the highest defense among Golem beings. There are only a few populations existing in Burning Ruins.

1018401.bookDesc: YellowApophis is said to have changed its skin due to the fire of Burning Ruins.

1018402.bookDesc: There is a myth that each Sphinx was transformed to a different figure after they landed on the earth.

1018403.bookDesc: Golem has many cracks and breaks all over its surface. Unlike what it looks like, it's stronger than any other Golems. I think it's true that the more attack it got hit, the stronger it becomes.

1018501.bookDesc: The evolutionary form of Arachne. It has longer legs than Arachne and a long tail like a scorpion. It uses a barton as the main weapon instead of the trident.

1018502.bookDesc: Originally it wanted to walk the path of immortality. However, turning itself into an undead mage was resurrected by a mysterious being.  Hidden and wrapped inside its cape and hate, you are unable to see its face but only see the glare that seers out of the inside of mage’s cape.that seers out of the inside of mage’s cape.

1018503.bookDesc: Prior known to be a god intrigued with thunder, now the mage’s main interest is to harass and destroy anything that moves within the human world. With the face of human and a broken wings of a bird, it continues to make havoc and chaos with his stake and hammer to punish all human beings.

1018601.bookDesc: A flying fish with eyes of a human and nose of a sawshark. This fish-looking monster is capable of flying.

1018602.bookDesc: Has the form of a salamander that walks on 2 legs, with blue skin (white on the stomach). Holds a sword on one hand and a shield on the other, wearing an armor.

1018701.bookDesc: Has the form of a salamander that walks on 2 legs, with green skin (white on the stomach). Holds a spear with both hands, wearing an armor.

1018702.bookDesc: A duck-looking creature with the eyes, arms, and legs of a human. It has webbed feet attached on the human legs.

1018801.bookDesc: Water that walks on two feet, taking the shape of a human. Native of the river in WestBorderlands, it has the rocks of the WestBorderlands on its body. The cute looks of it sometimes make people forget that it is a monster.

1018901.bookDesc: A monster born from quartz that drifted into the GreatFalls and became monsterized. It hides its four grotesque legs to mimic an ordinary rock, only to reveal them and pounce when prey draws near.

1019002.bookDesc: An amphibious, reptilian monster. While its body is lizard-like, it possesses the claws and feet of a bird. The eyes on its face are vestigial. Its true eye is located on its chest.

1019101.bookDesc: A fish inhabiting the GreatFalls that was corrupted by an evil spirit. Originally flightless, it gained the ability to fly using its fins after its monster transformation.

1019201.bookDesc: A four-legged tortoise monster. Once docile, it became violent after quartz fragments from the upstream Quartz River became embedded on its shell.

1019301.bookDesc: A mining monster that used to live by eating quartz in the river. After being pushed out by stronger monsters, it drifted downstream to find quartz. It has a black face with a bizarre, bulging belly and carries a rotten pickaxe.

1019401.bookDesc: A creature with a human face, ram horns, and tiger claws that travels on clouds. Originally a deity, it was cast out after turning into a monster and eventually took refuge in the GreatFalls.

1074501.name: 극락조귀
1074501.bookDesc: There is a game in which people force a phoenix to try to lull venomous snakes to sleep with its singing. If it failed, the phoenix would be killed by the angry snakes.

1075501.name: 궁기
1075501.bookDesc: This ancient monster blessed all that was evil and harmed all that was good during its reign of terror. The good mages were eventually able to defeat it, sealing its body and soul within hundreds of amulet.

1085001.bookDesc: 원래는 사람들을 도와주던 선한 용 이었지만, 하늘로 승천하지 못하고 지상에서 머물다 악의 기운에 사로잡혀 마물이 되었다. 사람들 때문에 하늘로 승천하지 못했다고 생각하여, 고락봉 깊숙한 곳 에서 사람들을 위협하며 살아가고 있다.

1094401.bookDesc: When I was young, Turtle Island was a peaceful little island. with the shelter of Giant Turtle Guardian, human and  turtles lived happily together. The guardian was an island and our god.

1094501.bookDesc: The monsters came from all quarters without notice. We were helpless against them. Many people were killed or injured including my parents.

1094601.bookDesc: People hurried to Turtle Guardian and ask for help. Guardian said, "They are aim on me. I will deal with them. Leave this island!"

1094701.bookDesc: Guardian told me, "Go out and find my friend, Giant Guardian Tree. he is the one can save the world."

1094801.bookDesc: As Turtle Guardian told us, we set out on a journey of refuge. Everyone gathered for the dock.

1094901.bookDesc: However, the monsters have been tracking us down. The islanders hurried on to the fire ship while I and the young men blocked them.

1095001.bookDesc: It was an old dock in the northern mountainous region that arrived behind Turtle Island.

1095101.bookDesc: I broke up with the islanders at the dock because of what Turtle Guardian said to me. I set off to meet his friend.

1095201.bookDesc: From ZephyrHall I have heard about Heaven's Column and CelestialUnso, who enables to guide to Giant Tree Forest.

1095301.bookDesc: CelestialUnso refusde to guide to Giant Tree Forest because of danger. However, when I brought up the story of Turtle Guardian, she opened the way to the forest. I have promised to repay her kindness.

1095401.bookDesc: When I arrived at  Giant Tree Forest, I was so tired from the long trip that I collapsed. Fortunately, a villager from Evergreen City found me and rescued me.

1095501.bookDesc: I asked about Giant Guardian Tree. But no one knew what it is. At last I left Evergreen and went back to the deep forest.

1095601.bookDesc: I searched for Giant Guardian Tree in the dark forest, which was blind to all kinds of wild insects. I was getting tired because I could not find any footprint of it.

1095701.bookDesc: When I was about to give up all hope and was exhausted, Giant Guardian Tree appeared.

1095801.bookDesc: Giant Guaridan Tree told me that the death of Turtle Guardian is just the beginning. He said, "You have natural talent",  and encouraged me to train myself to save the world. The training was ... harsh.

1095901.bookDesc: Thanks to the help of Giant Guardian Tee, I crossed the threshold of death. I eventually reached state of 2nd Divine.

1099001.bookDesc: 정유년이 되자 갑자기 날뛰기 시작하는 닭처럼 생긴 요괴. 마을 안의 유정란을 훔쳐 자신의 후계자로 만들려고 한다. 닭처럼 생긴 요괴를 퇴치하고 유정란을 지키자.

1099101.bookDesc: 설날에 떡국을 먹으면 한살 먹는거라고 합니다. 두그릇 먹는다고 두살을 먹지는 않아요.

1099201.bookDesc: 광복은 "빛을 되찾았다"는 의미로 광복절은 일본 제국이 2차세계대전 패전 선언을 하며 일본의 식민지에서 국가가 해방.. 독립된 날이다.

1099301.bookDesc: 어린이날을 맞이해서 부모님께 이쁘고 멋진 장난감 선물을 받은 네코와 니코의 행복한 모습을 담았다. 네코와 니코는 오는 어버이날에 자신들이 부모님 기쁘게 해드리고 싶다고 생각한다.

1099401.bookDesc: 갑오년이 되자 지옥에서 갑오지신이 마구 날뛰며 청음관을 위협하고 있다. 귀혼의 영웅들이여 갑오지신을 퇴치하여 청음관의 평화를 지켜라.

1099501.bookDesc: 가정의 달을 맞이하여 행복한 네코가족들의 모습을 담았다. 네코가족들이 무사히 봄나들이를 즐길 수 있도록 모두가 물심양면 도와주고 각자의 가정에 대한 감사와 행복을 되새기는 5월이 되기를 바란다.

1099601.bookDesc: A TooniLand mascot that follows Caramel everywhere she goes. This SoulSaverOnline version only has one eye for the element of surprise. Like other dogs, he likes smelling things, barks to warn others of danger, and loves being petted.

1099701.name: 태극네코
1099701.bookDesc: Neko has volunteered to be the 12th player of the Korean Soccer Team for the 2010 South Africa World Cup. Give 'em hell, Korea!

1099801.name: 코리아빠
1099801.bookDesc: Once a notorious gang of footpads, this large family of Nekos now enjoys a happy normal life.

1099901.name: DJ네쿠
1099901.bookDesc: A hip hop DJ monster that wears a Neko mask. He entered the world of SoulSaverOnline to celebrate its 3rd anniversary.
